Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by Mithra Nyr - Follower (Mithra Nyr - Follower.esp).

Install this if Mithra Nyr - Follower.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.
